answer: Require each identity to lock 140 POA for 48 epochs and complete eleven unpredictable jobs per round, with a 10-of-18 established jury signing replayable receipts. One missed round freezes rewards; two slash 75% of the timber bond. Funding-linked entrants cross a lagoon where each new bond doubles, making clone costs geometric. The ledger verifies task hashes, quorum signatures, timestamps, and funding ancestry; a public beacon selects jobs and jurors after registration.
